name: Michigan
summary: Statutes: legislature.mi.gov serves one PDF per MCL section at a constructible URL (documents/mcl/pdf/MCL-{chapter}-{section}.pdf) with 'Complete Through PA N of YYYY'; WebFetch reads them but built URLs need user approval and the shell is refused (bot check on robots.txt), so Justia (2025, constructible) is the practical second fetch. Constitution: mcl-chap1.pdf (truncates at Art. IV). Court rules (MCR, MRE, MRPC), opinions, bound Mich App volumes and Supreme Court leave orders are only on www.courts.michigan.gov, whose robots.txt disallows everything: blocked, link-only, with no tier-2 text for the rules. Admin Code: ARS rule-set PDFs by GET (shell ok) and Cornell LII. Case law: Justia (Supreme Court; Court of Appeals published, unpublished, orders) by docket, slip pagination only.

citation_map.notes: MCL numbers are chapter.section (600.5805 = chapter 600, section 5805); the chapter is the leading digits before the dot, so the per-section PDF URL is fully determined: MCL-{chapter}-{section with letters upper-cased}.pdf. Michigan's own style (Michigan Appellate Opinion Manual) drops periods: 'MCL 600.5805', 'MCR 2.116(C)(10)', 'MRE 702', 'Const 1963, art 1, § 17', '285 Mich App 1; 776 NW2d 314 (2009)', 'lv den 505 Mich 1023'. Bluebook: Mich. Comp. Laws § 600.5805; Mich. Ct. R. 2.116; Mich. R. Evid. 702. A range 'MCL 600.5801-600.5869' is a span: the regex captures the first section only. Old 'MSA 27A.5805' (Michigan Statutes Annotated) numbering is not routed. Bare 'R 408.10011' and bare 'Docket No. 359401' are generic and need Michigan context (context_required). 'Const 1963' alone is used only by Michigan in practice, but 'Mich' is preferred. No public-domain citation: Michigan cites to Mich / Mich App (official, West-published) and NW2d/NW3d; unpublished COA opinions are cited by docket number and issue date (MCR 7.215(C)). CourtListener ids mich / michctapp are from memory and unverified. 'MRPC' is also Minnesota's abbreviation, so bare 'MRPC 1.7' is not routed by a Michigan pattern (Minnesota's record owns it); with Michigan context, read it from mi-rules-mrpc. 'Act N of YYYY' collides with Pennsylvania's form and is not routed; use 'YYYY PA N'. Court rules (MCR, MRE, MRPC) route to link-only rows: www.courts.michigan.gov is blocked (robots Disallow: /) and no tier-2 host carries them, so cite them by number and never quote. Case law routes to Justia first (slip pagination only); official Mich/Mich App pages and MSC leave orders have no permitted route. Blank-slip '___ Mich App ___' forms are matched by the reports pattern. Bare 'MRE NNN' / 'M.R.E. NNN' is context_required: Mississippi uses the same abbreviation (split 2026-10-17).

access.pattern_rules: chapter = digits before the dot, section = digits after it, with any letter suffix UPPER-cased (MCL 257.203a → MCL-257-203A.pdf). Lower-case 'mcl-' prefix also served (mcl-26-1.pdf, mcl-chap1.pdf). The www. host serves the same files. Whole act: MCL-ACT-{act}-OF-{year}.pdf. Repealed ranges are served under the first section of the range (600.5040-600.5065 under MCL-600-5040.pdf). Index (chapter → acts with section ranges): https://legislature.mi.gov/Laws/ChapterIndex → GetObject?objectName=mcl-chap{N}.

sources.title: Michigan Administrative Code (ARS — Administrative Rulemaking System)
sources.publisher: Michigan Office of Administrative Hearings and Rules (LARA)
sources.official_status_evidence: LARA 'Using the Michigan Administrative Code' page warns 'there may be errors contained in the code text'; no official-status statement.
sources.coverage: All current rule sets, one PDF (and HTML rendering) per rule set, listed by department and bureau.

access.pattern_rules: File name is the rule set's range ('R 408.10001 to R 408.10098.pdf'), not derivable from a single rule number. Append &ReturnHTML=True for HTML. Listing by GET: https://ars.apps.lara.state.mi.us/AdminCode/DeptBureauAdminCode?Department={department name, URL-encoded}[&Bureau={bureau}] — rows show each rule set's first and last rule. The home search form (AdminCode/AdminCode, field RuleNumber) is POST-only; a GET ?RuleNumber= returns the blank form.
access.navigation: DeptBureauAdminCode?Department=… (GET) → row whose range covers the rule → DownloadAdminCodeFile PDF. Use fetch_doc.py links on the listing and filter on the part number (e.g. '408\.100'). Filter on the bare part number (no 'R ' prefix): link text is 'PDF'/'HTML' and URLs encode the space as %20, so 'R 338\.3' returns 0 links.

automation.notes: Department names as in the form: 'Labor and Economic Opportunity', 'Environment, Great Lakes and Energy', 'Licensing and Regulatory Affairs', etc. MIOSHA listing is ~152K chars.
